content.title: 主谓一致(1)速查:集合名词 · and 主语 · each/every · a number of / the number of
content.intro: 主谓一致就是谓语动词的‘数’要和主语的‘数’一致。本单元三大考点:① 集合名词看整体用单数、看成员用复数;② and 连接两者用复数、同一事物用单数;③ each/every/either/neither + 单数,a number of 用复数、the number of 用单数,以及 neither…nor… / either…or… 的就近原则。

rows: 单数:The team is the best in the league.(看作一个队)
复数:The team are arguing among themselves.(强调队员)
复数:Tom and Jerry were in the same unit.
单数:Bread and butter is on the table. / The poet and soldier is …
单数:Each of the soldiers was given a gun.
a number of + 复数名词
复数:A number of boats were hit.
the number of + 复数名词
单数:The number of casualties was rising.
就近:Neither the captain nor his men were ready.

specialRules.rule: police / people / cattle 等通常作复数
specialRules.mark: The police were searching the area.

specialRules.rule: every…and every… 与 many a + 单数名词,谓语用单数
specialRules.mark: Many a man has died for peace.

specialRules.rule: 集合名词后用 it/itself → 单数;用 they/their/themselves → 复数(靠代词判断)
specialRules.mark: The crew did its job. / The crew did their jobs.

specialRules.rule: a number of(许多)≠ the number of(……的数目),前复后单

why: ‘数’的一致由主语真正的中心和说话人的视角决定:把集合体当‘一个’还是‘一群’,a number of 强调‘很多个’(复数),the number of 强调‘数目’这一概念(单数);并列主语是否指同一人或同一物,决定用单数还是复数。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空/改错高频:the number of vs a number of 的单复数;集合名词随语境单复数。
neither…nor… / either…or… / not only…but also… 的就近原则。
every…and every… / each + 单数名词、many a + 单数名词一律用单数谓语。

examVsReal.exam: The team is playing well.（看作整体，单数）
examVsReal.real: 英式口语常说 The team are playing well.
examVsReal.note: 英式英语里集合名词常配复数动词;考试按‘整体=单数’更稳。

examVsReal.exam: Neither of the plans was perfect.（neither of + 单数）
examVsReal.real: 口语里也常听到 Neither of the plans were perfect.
examVsReal.note: 书面/考试用单数 was 最稳妥。
